basic_info.description: Welcome to 124 Avocet Way, a luxurious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse epitomizing modern comfort. Built in 2016, this elegant home spans three thoughtfully designed floors in San Francisco's newly developed Shipyard. The first floor features a versatile room and a convenient powder room, perfect for guests or a home office. On the second floor, an open kitchen seamlessly integrates with the living and dining areas, creating a spacious atmosphere ideal for everyday living and entertaining, opening onto a large wood deck for relaxing and BBQs. The top floor offers privacy and tranquility, housing two bedrooms and two bathrooms, including a master suite with a walk-in closet and a serene master bathroom. This layout ensures comfort and space for everyone in the home. The 2-car tandem garage provides ample parking and storage. Outside, a charming small garden offers a peaceful escape for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Close to water views, this stunning townhouse offers a picturesque setting with easy freeway access for convenient commuting. With its newer construction, this home is a rare find, representing exceptional value. Make this gorgeous townhouse your new home and enjoy the lifestyle you deserve.
